prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: trying to change a flight and I get an error on your side. System down?
Delta: There haven't been any reports of our website/app being down. *ABN

Customer: Trying to change flight w/  - was so close to being done and poof💨*call dropped* No call back. Now in line waiting for another call😭😤😫
Delta: HI Anna. Please DM your confirmation number, and I'll check on this for you. Thanks. *TMS https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: I need help changing a ticket. Keep trying to call and trying online. Help?! 🙂
Delta: Hey Matt, can you DM your confirmation # to the link provided? I will be glad to help.  *TBT https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Trying to change a flight for Thanksgiving, but website is cropped at pay window... thanks a lot
Delta: Alex, please contact our Online Customer Support Desk for assistance by dialing 888 750 3284. *ALS

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: rebooking_change):
"""trying to change a ticket and getting really frustrated with roadblocks.  Can you help???"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hey there! Please DM your confirmation number using the link below and we’ll sort out the change for you. https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m
